Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

In a large bowl, combine the Betty Crocker Yellow Cake Mix, 4 eggs, melted butter, milk, and vanilla extract. 2. Mix until smooth and well combined. 3. Who else lives olives? 🫒 Recipe -  Olive and Garlic Cream Cheese Buns  / Ingredients: For the dough: - 350g all purpose flour (2 cups + 3/4 cup + 1 tablespoon) - 35g granulated sugar (3 tablespoons) - 7g instant dry yeast  (1 packet) - 7g fine sea salt (1 teaspoon + 1/4 teaspoon) - 50g unsalted butter, melted and cooled (3 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon) - 1 large egg - 150g warm milk  (1/2 cup + 2 tablespoons) - 100g grated Cheddar Cheese (1 cup) - 100g grated Emmentaler Cheese (1 cup) For the filling: - 200g Chive Philadelphia Cream Cheese - Green Olives - Kalamata Olives - Grated Emmentaler Cheese  - An egg, for an egg wash - Microgreens, for toppings Instructions: 1. To the bowl of your stand mixer, add the flour, salt, sugar, instant dry yeast, grated Cheddar and grated Emmentaler cheese. Whisk everything together. 2. Next, add the milk, egg and melted butter. 3. Using the dough hook attachment, knead on low speed until the dough becomes smooth and forms a ball, about 6-8 minutes. 4. Once ready, transfer the dough to a clean, lightly oiled bowl. 5. Cover and let it rise at room temperature for 2 hours. 6. After 2 hours, punch the dough down and divide it into 8 equal balls, about 105 g each. 7. Place them on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper, cover and let them rise for another 1 hour. 8. Preheat the oven to 180°C. 9. Brush each bun with the egg wash. 10. Fill each bun with a little cream cheese and top with the olives. 11. Sprinkle with more grated cheese. 12. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the buns are golden brown. 13. Once ready, top with microgreens and serve warm. #bread #breakfastrecipes #foodtok #asmr #baking

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

videos.caption: Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍝 The viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits everytime!  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search "Osta Recipes" on the App Store or Google Play store. This app makes organizing recipes 100% easier 🫶🏼 Recipe: Chicken- • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp Creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce- • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta- • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ small yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp Creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins and marinate in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice for at least 30 minutes - 1 hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour and let rest on wire rack for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. 3. In a saucepan, mix buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce. Toss fried chicken in the hot honey sauce until fully coated. 4. Boil penne pasta until al dente. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy ;) #hothoney #pasta #fyp #recipesoftiktok #recipetok

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. This is such a great healthy dessert, hits all the right spots, and is one of those healthy recipes that truly hits the spot! Beignets from Princess & the Frog 👸🏾  The viral recipe with over 7+ million views, so many of you tried it and loved it! For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store. This app makes organizing recipes 100% easier 🫶🏼 Ingredients: • ½ + ⅓ cup warm whole milk (heat about 45 seconds) • ¼ cup sugar • 2¼ tsp active dry yeast • 1 egg, room temp • 1 tbsp pure vanilla extract • 2½ cups bread flour • 1¼ tsp salt • ¼ cup softened unsalted butter Topping: • Honey drizzle • Powdered sugar, sifted Instructions: 	1. In a bowl combine warm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy. 	2. Add egg and vanilla, whisk until combined. Add bread flour and salt, mix until a shaggy dough forms. Add softened butter and knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. 	3. Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours or until doubled in size. Then refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.  	4. Roll dough out on a floured surface to about ½ inch thick. Cut into squares. Cover and let rest 20–30 minutes until slightly puffy. 	5. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry beignets in batches until golden brown on both sides. Remove and drain on a rack. 	6. Drizzle with honey and generously sift powdered sugar over the top. Serve warm and enjoy :)  #beignets #princessandthefrog #bakingrecipe #recipe #fyp

7 Viral Recipes That Took Over the Internet 🔥📱✨ Easy to make, big on flavor, and definitely worth trying! 😋 1️⃣ Baked Feta Pasta 🍅🧀🍝 Ingredients 🛒 • 2 cups cherry tomatoes 🍅 • 8 oz (225 g) feta cheese 🧀 • 3 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced 🧄 • 1 tsp dried oregano 🌿 • Salt & black pepper • 8 oz (225 g) pasta 🍝 • Fresh basil, for garnish 🌿 How to make 👨‍🍳 Add tomatoes, feta, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper to a baking dish. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 30 minutes. Cook the pasta separately, mash the baked feta and tomatoes together, then mix with pasta. Finish with fresh basil. 😍🔥 2️⃣ Cloud Bread ☁️🍞 Ingredients 🛒 • 3 large eggs, separated 🥚 • 3 tbsp cream cheese • ¼ tsp cream of tartar • ¼ tsp salt • 1 tbsp sweetener, optional How to make 👨‍🍳 Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Mix yolks with cream cheese, then gently fold in the whites. Spoon onto a lined baking sheet and bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25–30 minutes. ☁️✨ 3️⃣ Ranch Water 🍋‍🟩🧊 Ingredients 🍹 • 2 oz (60 ml) tequila • ½ oz (15 ml) fresh lime juice 🍋‍🟩 • Sparkling water • Ice 🧊 • Lime slice How to make 🍹 Fill a glass with ice, add tequila and lime juice, then top with sparkling water. Stir gently and garnish with lime. Refreshing and super simple! ✨ 4️⃣ Crooked Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪🍫 Ingredients 🛒 • 1 cup (227 g) butter 🧈 • 1 cup (220 g) brown sugar • ½ cup (100 g) sugar • 2 eggs 🥚 • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 2¾ cups (345 g) flour • 1 tsp baking soda • 1 tsp salt • 2 cups chocolate chips 🍫 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mix the wet ingredients, then add the dry ingredients. Fold in chocolate chips. Scoop into large uneven balls and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. Cool slightly before serving. 🤤 5️⃣ Viral Cucumber Salad 🥒🌶️ Ingredients 🛒 • Cucumbers, thinly sliced 🥒 • Soy sauce • Rice vinegar • Sesame oil • Chili crisp 🌶️ • Sesame seeds • Green onions How to make 👨‍🍳 Toss everything together and let sit for 15–20 minutes. Finish with sesame seeds and green onions. Crunchy, spicy, and addictive! 😍🔥 6️⃣ Banana Bread Baked Oats 🍌🥣 Ingredients 🛒 • 2 ripe bananas 🍌 • 2 eggs 🥚 • ½ cup (120 ml) milk • ¼ cup (60 ml) maple syrup 🍁 • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1½ cups (135 g) oats • 1 tsp baking powder • 1 tsp cinnamon • ¼ cup chocolate chips 🍫 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mash the bananas, mix in the remaining ingredients, and pour into a baking dish. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30–35 minutes. 🍌✨ 7️⃣ No-Bake Strawberry Cheesecake Cups 🍓🍰 Ingredients 🛒 • 1 cup (200 g) graham cracker crumbs • 4 tbsp melted butter 🧈 • 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese • ½ cup (120 ml) powdered sugar • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1 cup (240 ml) whipped cream • 1 cup chopped strawberries 🍓 How to make 👨‍🍳 Mix graham crumbs with melted butter and press into cups. Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar and vanilla, then fold in whipped cream.
